office_does: A Benton County District Court judge, elected countywide for four years, hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor cases, traffic and other infractions, small claims, anti-harassment matters and civil cases up to $100,000.
race_blurb: Judge Dan Kathren, first elected in 2011, is the only candidate. He submitted no statement to the voters' guide.

candidates.summary: Benton County District Court judge since 2011 after more than 12 years in private practice; submitted no voters'-guide statement. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Judge in Position 3 since he was first elected in 2011 [S2]
Unopposed in 2018; 98.4% as the only named candidate in 2022 [S3][S4]
Submitted no statement to the 2026 voters' guide [S1]
